entities.name: Necros
entities.description: A human-colonized planet, a non-canon plane subtype, and location of Tranquil Repose.

entities.name: Tranquil Repose
entities.description: The finest funeral home in the galaxy, where the dead were held in suspended animation; later Davros's base and destroyed by a bomb.

entities.name: Resting Ones
entities.description: People placed into suspended animation at Tranquil Repose.

entities.name: Garden of Fond Memories
entities.description: Garden outside Tranquil Repose with statues of the Resting Ones.

entities.name: Davros
entities.description: Creator of the Daleks who took over Tranquil Repose under an alias.

entities.name: Daleks
entities.description: A race Davros experimented on and bred a new generation of from the bodies.

entities.name: Dalek Empire
entities.description: Arrived to take Davros to Skaro for trial.

entities.name: Skaro
entities.description: Where the Dalek Empire meant to try Davros.

events.summary: Davros takes over Tranquil Repose as a base under the alias the Great Healer.
events.quote: Tranquil Repose was eventually taken over and used as a base by Davros

events.summary: Davros mutates bodies into new Daleks and turns the rest into protein sold to developing planets.
events.quote: The bodies of people of status and ambition were mutated and conditioned into his new generation of Daleks.

events.summary: The Dalek Empire arrives to take Davros to Skaro for trial.
events.quote: The Dalek Empire arrived to take Davros to Skaro for trial.

events.summary: Tranquil Repose is destroyed by a bomb meant to kill Davros.
events.quote: Tranquil Repose was eventually destroyed when a bomb was detonated in an attempt to kill Davros.

relations.quote: the location of Tranquil Repose, the finest funeral home in the galaxy

relations.note: Came to take him to trial
relations.quote: The Dalek Empire arrived to take Davros to Skaro for trial.
